event_protocol.producer: independent reproduction/test worker in a clean clone of the same base commit
event_protocol.payload: raw command, exit status, and bounded stdout/stderr from selected reproduction tests
event_protocol.release_predicate: main working tree has a non-empty persisted diff while worker is running
event_protocol.rollback: post-result patch history remains; the agent must amend/revert real files

state_attestation.baseline_probe: git HEAD plus clean index/worktree digest
state_attestation.checkpoint_probe: git diff --binary plus untracked-file content digest

react.evidence_delivery: same native evidence producer awaited synchronously

linear.evidence_delivery: same native evidence is materialized before dependent work

async.evidence_delivery: raw result delivered only after a persisted native-state checkpoint

modes.score_policy: the unchanged source-native evaluator scores final persisted state in every mode
